localizedValues.name: C62
localizedValues.description: Pet Friendly. Per night pet fee applies, declare pets and pay fee when you make reservation or check in at the park. Read and understand pet rules. This one room cabin sleeps a maximum of 4.  It contains one full sized bed and one 2-person bunk, and also features a small desk with a bench seat.  The cabin has a heating/air-conditioning wall unit and a ceiling fan with lights.  A 120V AC outlet is available.  A fire pit and picnic table is in front of the cabin.  Cabins have no plumbing and cooking is not allowed inside.

localizedValues.name: C86
localizedValues.description: This two room cabin sleeps a maximum of 6.  It contains one full sized bed in one room and two 2-person bunks in the second room, and also features a small desk with a bench seat.  The cabin has a heating/air-conditioning wall unit and a ceiling fan with lights.  A 120V AC outlet is available.  A fire pit and picnic table is in front of the cabin.  Cabins have no plumbing and cooking is not allowed inside.

localizedValues.name: G1
localizedValues.description:
The group camp is located in a grassy section and is well shaded. Restroom facilities are nearby. There is a year-round creek adjacent to the group camp that provides excellent trout and bass fishing.
There is a minimum billable party size for this site. The unit price for a block of people may not accurately reflect the total price required. Confirm total payment at checkout.
